mapper.select: select id::text from series where slug = #{slug} limit 1
select id::text from series where is_published = true order by created_at asc
mapper.insert: insert into series_subscriptions (user_id, series_id, status) values (cast(#{userId} as uuid), cast(#{seriesId} as uuid), 'active') on conflict (user_id, series_id) do update set status = 'active'

insert into series_progress (user_id, series_id, total_items, learned_items, due_items) values ( cast(#{userId} as uuid), cast(#{seriesId} as uuid), ( select count(*) from learning_items li join packs p on p.id = li.pack_id where p.series_id = cast(#{seriesId} as uuid) and li.is_published = true ), 0, 0 ) on conflict (user_id, series_id) do nothing
mapper.select: select unnest( case when cardinality(accepted_answers) = 0 then array[target_text] else accepted_answers end ) from learning_items where id = cast(#{itemId} as uuid)
select target_text from learning_items where id = cast(#{itemId} as uuid) limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into user_answers ( user_id, learning_item_id, typed_answer, normalized_answer, is_correct ) values ( cast(#{userId} as uuid), cast(#{itemId} as uuid), #{typedAnswer}, #{normalizedAnswer}, #{isCorrect} )
insert into favorites (user_id, learning_item_id) values (cast(#{userId} as uuid), cast(#{itemId} as uuid)) on conflict (user_id, learning_item_id) do nothing
mapper.delete: delete from favorites where user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and learning_item_id = cast(#{itemId} as uuid)
mapper.insert: insert into review_schedules ( user_id, learning_item_id, ease_factor, interval_days, repetition_count, next_review_at, last_reviewed_at, last_result ) values ( cast(#{userId} as uuid), cast(#{itemId} as uuid), #{easeFactor}, #{intervalDays}, #{repetitionCount}, #{nextReviewAt}, now(), #{lastResult} ) on conflict (user_id, learning_item_id) do update set ease_factor = excluded.ease_factor, interval_days = excluded.interval_days, repetition_count = excluded.repetition_count, next_review_at = excluded.next_review_at, last_reviewed_at = now(), last_result = excluded.last_result, updated_at = now()

insert into review_logs ( user_id, learning_item_id, result, new_interval_days, new_ease_factor ) values ( cast(#{userId} as uuid), cast(#{itemId} as uuid), #{result}, #{newIntervalDays}, #{newEaseFactor} )
mapper.update: update review_schedules set last_reviewed_at = now(), next_review_at = #{nextReviewAt}, last_result = #{lastResult}, updated_at = now() where user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and learning_item_id = cast(#{itemId} as uuid)

update series_progress sp set total_items = ( select count(*) from learning_items li join packs p on p.id = li.pack_id where p.series_id = cast(#{seriesId} as uuid) and li.is_published = true ), learned_items = ( select count(*) from learning_items li join packs p on p.id = li.pack_id where p.series_id = cast(#{seriesId} as uuid) and li.is_published = true and exists ( select 1 from review_schedules rs where rs.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and rs.learning_item_id = li.id and rs.next_review_at > now() ) ), due_items = ( select count(*) from review_schedules rs join learning_items li on li.id = rs.learning_item_id join packs p on p.id = li.pack_id where rs.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and p.series_id = cast(#{seriesId} as uuid) and rs.next_review_at <= now() ), updated_at = now() where sp.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and sp.series_id = cast(#{seriesId} as uuid)
mapper.delete: delete from review_schedules where user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and learning_item_id = cast(#{itemId} as uuid)
delete from user_answers where user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and learning_item_id = cast(#{itemId} as uuid)
mapper.select: select s.id::text from learning_items li join packs p on p.id = li.pack_id join series s on s.id = p.series_id where li.id = cast(#{itemId} as uuid) limit 1

with current_item as ( select li.id, li.pack_id, li.order_index, p.series_id from learning_items li join packs p on p.id = li.pack_id where li.id = cast(#{itemId} as uuid) ), next_in_pack as ( select li.id::text as next_id from learning_items li join current_item ci on ci.pack_id = li.pack_id where li.is_published = true and li.order_index > ci.order_index order by li.order_index asc limit 1 ), next_in_series as ( select li.id::text as next_id from current_item ci join packs p on p.series_id = ci.series_id join learning_items li on li.pack_id = p.id where li.is_published = true and ( p.order_index > (select p2.order_index from packs p2 where p2.id = ci.pack_id) or (p.order_index = (select p2.order_index from packs p2 where p2.id = ci.pack_id) and li.order_index > ci.order_index) ) order by p.order_index asc, li.order_index asc limit 1 ) select coalesce( (select next_id from next_in_pack), (select next_id from next_in_series) )
